problem:
Consider the set ${{p}_{1}(t),{p}_{2}(t),{p}_{3}(t)}$ of polynomials from $R[t],$ where

$$
{p}_{1}(t)=1+t+{t}^{2},\,{p}_{2}(t)=1-t,\,{p}_{3}(t)=2+{t}^{2}.
$$

 

If the set is linearly dependent, find the value of $\frac{{x}_{1}}{{x}_{3}}$ from a non-zero solution of ${x}_{1}\cdot {p}_{1}(t)+{x}_{2}\cdot {p}_{2}(t)+{x}_{3}\cdot {p}_{3}(t)=0.$

activity_context.topic_title: Linear Independence in Abstract Vector Spaces
